{{Quote|Oh, how about the four grains of silicartha I dumped in your soup? On Tatooine, that's enough to kill a fifty-pound sand-borer.|Luke Skywalker, to an Imperial officer|<ref name="SW63">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref>}}
A '''sand-borer''' was a [[Species/Legends|creature]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. According to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a 50-[[Pound/Legends|pound]] sand-borer could be killed with [[silicartha]].<ref name="SW63" />
